items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And they had another guy by the name of Tommy Morgan, Tom Morgan.

ctx.x: Yeah, he plays very good mouth organ. And they had another guy by the name of Tommy Morgan, Tom Morgan. But any way it was just nice to see it because I had never seen the movie and it was on television last night, and it occurred to me how this whole background, musical background occurred. It was just a spontaneous thing.

And after that I went to New York, Philadelphia, Baltimore -- not Baltimore, Boston, and Washington with Benny, accompanying a singer, Marie Muldas. In the band was Harry Edison Addison, Marty Harris playing piano, John Williams playing bass, Earl --
